title: The pace you need on the current segment
description: The watch screen tells apart the number right now, a completed lap and the whole workout.

blocks.text: An average mixes walking, stops and the running part together.

quote.text: This app is OK at best. If you follow it you will get to where you want to be. However, it does not give you split paces in real time or in the summary l, everything is an average. There is also no update when running miles vs time, which is super frustrating.

blocks.text: Let the main metric and a clear period be chosen. After the finish, show the individual laps and transitions alongside the overall recording.
The target is set by the chosen session or by the person; the app does not need to invent one pace that suits all.
